title: Embodied autonomous selfhood is a precondition for world modeling

statements.text: Besides space, time and cause, IWMT adds embodied autonomous selfhood as a precondition for integrated world modeling. For there to be something that it is like, workspace dynamics must be grounded in models of autonomous embodiment.
